title: Cloud Identity, Google Workspace and directory synchronisation

videos.script: Google Cloud does not keep a list of people. Every user and every group lives in a directory, and Google Cloud trusts it. {{trust}} For a company, that directory is Cloud Identity, or Google Workspace, which is Cloud Identity with email and documents on top. {{products}} Verifying the company's domain is what creates the organisation at the top of the tree. {{domain}} And the directory has its own administrators. A super administrator can reset anybody's password, Owner of production included. So those accounts are the keys to everything. {{superadmin}} The directory is also what makes offboarding one act. Suspend the account, and every role it had stops working, in every project. {{offboard}} In your lab, you will write the planner's on-call group as Terraform, with a member. {{groups}} And most companies already have a directory somewhere else. They copy it in, sign in through it, or trust it directly. You will see what each choice costs. {{end}}
